title: h3spec HTTP/3 Server Conformance Pipeline Verification
verification_method: Build, requirement-home tests, plan-only h3spec runner execution, repo-local h3spec acquisition, parser smoke test, and SpecTrace validation.
scope: Verify that the repository exposes an advisory h3spec HTTP/3 server conformance pipeline that captures raw output, normalizes results, maps RFC 9114/RFC 9204 failures, and keeps failures as TODO/triage evidence until protocol-owned requirements close them.
procedure: Run `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/interop/http3-h3spec/Install-H3SpecTool.ps1 -PassThruJson` on platforms where Docker or a native release asset is available.
expected_result: The build and requirement-home tests pass, the acquisition path stores h3spec under `.artifacts/tools` without global PATH setup, the plan-only runner emits raw-log placeholders and parsed report artifacts, the parser maps sample HTTP/3 and QPACK failures to RFC 9114 and RFC 9204 TODO rows, and SpecTrace validation accepts the new artifacts.
evidence: 2026-05-25: `dotnet build Incursa.Quic.slnx -c Release --no-restore` passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors.

2026-05-25: parser smoke under `.artifacts/http3-h3spec-parser-smoke` mapped sample h3spec failures to `RFC 9114 Section 4.1` / `http3-adapter-boundary` and `RFC 9204 Section 3.1` / `qpack-stream-state-boundary` TODO rows.

2026-06-19: `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/interop/http3-h3spec/Install-H3SpecTool.ps1 -Force -PassThruJson` acquired upstream h3spec `v0.1.13` under `.artifacts/tools/h3spec-v0.1.13` without global PATH setup; `.artifacts/tools/h3spec-v0.1.13/h3spec-tool.json` SHA256 `C1B013A266A05C93202087E34A52716D9D8A102AAC23976E16BF359A38930FA3`.

2026-06-19: live local acquired-h3spec run `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/interop/http3-h3spec/Run-H3Spec.ps1 -ArtifactsRoot .artifacts/http3-h3spec -RunId 20260619T0037Z-acquired-live -AcquireH3Spec -NoValidateCertificate -TimeoutMilliseconds 2000 -NoBuild` executed 49 cases and reported 41 failures, including 15 RFC 9114/RFC 9204 failures; report `.artifacts/http3-h3spec/20260619T0037Z-acquired-live/h3spec-report.md` SHA256 `CBD058C5ABA84BAB1825AC52D163221243E01D0AB20DE3FAC3A87D6ADAFA5FD0` and results `.artifacts/http3-h3spec/20260619T0037Z-acquired-live/h3spec-results.json` SHA256 `E2A88A8F7CAA0FA5C7623626EA9203C75483296142D54A5AE563FA08F22B35B5`.
status_summary: Passed for the advisory h3spec harness, repo-local acquisition path, parser, report, and CI-dispatch surfaces. The preserved plan-only evidence proves artifact generation only. The 2026-06-19 live local acquired-h3spec run is advisory conformance triage: it executed 49 cases, reported 41 failures, and mapped 15 failures to RFC 9114/RFC 9204 follow-up areas without promoting or demoting production support claims until protocol-owned requirements and tests close the underlying behavior.
